headline: Recent technological problems in the U.S. are not related to cyberattacks
summary: A recent series of US technology service outages is not related to cyberattacks, the country's top national security official said Tuesday. Instead, outdated computer systems needing updates are to blame.
why: Widespread IT outages can disrupt businesses and financial services, and investors watch whether such failures reflect security threats or infrastructure weakness.
original_headline: Recientes problemas tecnológicos en EU no están relacionados con ciberataques
